verdict.rationale: Shopify documents its own AI Toolkit skill, installed as a plugin into an assistant such as Claude, that turns natural-language requests into the matching UCP CLI command. It also advertises spinning up a store from a simple prompt, so the core story is delivered first-party. The runtime probes exercised the CLI directly rather than through natural language. missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, documentation showing natural-language control beyond the catalog-search example (carts, checkout, orders).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask your assistant in natural language ("find me crewneck sweaters under $50") and the skill picks the right UCP CLI command
Spin up your store from a simple prompt or with a pre-built template.
